impact: Users may have been unable to access or receive prompt responses with Microsoft 365 Copilot or Copilot Notebooks.

updates.content:
Title: We're looking into a potential problem impacting Microsoft 365 Copilot

User impact: We're checking for potential impact to your users.

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with Microsoft 365 Copilot and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Some users may be unable to access or receive prompt responses with Microsoft 365 Copilot or Copilot Notebooks

User impact: Users may be unable to access or receive prompt responses with Microsoft 365 Copilot or Copilot Notebooks.

More info: Users may experience failing requests for the following scenarios:
- Image generation requests in Copilot
- Prompt generation requests in Copilot
- Failures when attempting to access or view Copilot Notebooks

Current status: We've received reports from a subset of affected users who have reported impact to prompt and image generation in Copilot, as well as failures when accessing Copilot Notebooks. We've isolated that impact is caused by a licensing mismatch which is causing Copilot to view affected users as unlicensed, preventing them from completing requests or accessing Notebooks. We're developing a fix to remediate the discrepancy, and we aim to provide more details on our fix and a timeline to release in our next scheduled update.

Scope of impact: This incident impacts some users attempting to generate images or prompts using Copilot or accessing Copilot notebooks. This section may be updated as the investigation progresses.

Root cause: A licensing mismatch is causing Copilot to view affected users as unlicensed, preventing them from completing requests or accessing Notebooks.

Next update by: Thursday, September 24, 2026, at 9:00 PM UTC
